correctness.rationale: Pinned proof reduces threshold-three activation on 4-regular C_n^2 to simultaneous leaf/isolate pruning of initially inactive induced subgraph: whole activation iff it is a forest. Cyclic white-vertex gaps have no adjacent unit gaps and at least one gap >=3 (the m=2 n=5 boundary is handled separately). Slack n=2m-u+e with e>=1 gives m_max=floor(2(n-1)/3) and mu=ceil((n+2)/3). For n mod3=0,1,2 the proof exhausts slack classes A,B,C and derives exact labelled counts and per-path leaf-stripping completion times; for n=3k+2 classes with two cuts yield times max(r,k-r). Independently enumerated original synchronous infection subsets for every 5<=n<=12 and matched optimum/time histograms. Finite confirmation not proof for arbitrary n.
